title: Control your coding agent from your phone
caption:
Your coding agent. Controlled from your phone. 📱

T3 Code is a free open-source app: install it on your computer, then run Claude Code, Codex or Cursor from anywhere. It works with the subscriptions you already have, and it's very early, so expect rough edges.
MIT license. Not affiliated with this project or with Claude.

Comment PHONE and I'll send you the link. Tag a friend who codes from the couch. Follow @StickMindR8!
